什么是 ISO 6346？
ISO 6346 是集装箱标识的国际标准，规定了箱主代码、设备类别字母、六位序列号、校验位以及尺寸和箱型代码。

Each / the first ten characters gets a value (letters have values from 10 up, skipping multiples / 11). Each value is multiplied by 2 to the power / its position (1, 2, 4, 8 and so on), the results are added, divided by 11, and the remainder (with 10 counted as 0) is the check digit.

Most often it is a typo or a misread character, such as O for 0 or I for 1. Check the number on the container door and on the booking or bill / lading. If it still fails, ask the shipping line before you file the document.
